content: This cycle turns Trail-as-Product from a schema plus one enforcer (Orchestrator) and one materializer (pmcro-trail) into a complete, five-role loop: every phase now has a real plugin with its own contract, not a single agent hand-simulating four roles per cycle (which is exactly how every prior cycle in this repo's own history, including this one, was actually run — the plugins exist now, but this cycle itself still ran by an agent following each new role's run.*.asset.md directly, since no scheduler wires them together yet). The queue-item schema is a small but real extension of Trail-as-Product's own principle: any durable structured artifact this colony produces — not just trail frames — gets a declared schema rather than ad hoc shape. The account-level portable skill the user also asked for is deliberately not part of this trail (it isn't a repo file any phase here owns) and is proposed separately via propose_skills in the same turn this trail is sealed.

next_seed.summary: Hand-run one full cycle using the new plugins end-to-end on a trivial real task (the long-carried-over 'task-hand-simulate-orchestrate-run' seed, now upgradeable to 'task-hand-run-full-five-plugin-cycle') to prove the five contracts actually compose in practice, not just that each validates in isolation.
